description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a mountain scree slope: grey quartzite stones and boulders of many sizes packed together, patches of yellow lichen, a few tufts of dry grass, muted palette of stone greys and pale ochres, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
